note: The platform's roles and what each may do, and the workspace roles a client's members hold (SC-66). Written by hand (not generated); loaded at migrate time into roles, permissions and role_permissions.

permissions.description: See the console: the overview, clients, staff, demo requests and the audit log
Set up a new client
Configure a client's agents, supply-chain profile, channels and rules
Remind distributors and ask for stock exports
Invite a client's people, renew invitations, change their access, deactivate them
Change a client's plan and take it live
Invite colleagues to the console
See the workspace: its batches, the journey of those that concern you, your inbox
See the client's figures: plans, nets, the P&L, write-offs
Read the workspace's audit log
Invite the workspace's people, change their roles, deactivate them
Change the workspace's guardrails
Confirm the Data agent's mapping and the guardrails
Upload a stock export for the Data agent
Give, pause or resume a distributor's one-time permission for the agents to act in its name
Send a batch's label photo
Approve a plan (the client's approver only)
Order under a scheme offered to your shop
Bid on a listing, ask about it and accept a counter
Confirm and collect a donation
Load the buyer's truck and run the van round
Issue the drafted invoice
See a batch's documents
Review the client's papers
See the Finance & ESG report

roles.name: Super admin
roles.description: Everything, including plans, going live and the platform's own staff

roles.name: Platform engineer
roles.description: Sets clients up and configures them; not plans, going live or staff

roles.name: Support
roles.description: Helps clients day to day: their setup, people and distributors; not plans, going live or staff

roles.name: Approver
roles.description: Approves the plans the agents make, with the money on screen

roles.name: Admin
roles.description: Runs the workspace: sign-in, people, guardrails, integrations, the audit log

roles.name: Member
roles.description: The client's own staff: sees the batches, the money and the reports

roles.name: Partner
roles.description: Distributors, kiranas and food banks the client invites

roles.name: Supply-chain operator
roles.description: Watches the batches, approves plans (as the client's approver) and sets the guardrails

roles.name: Distributor
roles.description: Owns the stock: gives the agents a one-time permission, sends label photos, dispatches and issues invoices

roles.name: Kirana retailer
roles.description: Orders under the scheme offered to the shop

roles.name: Marketplace buyer
roles.description: Bids on the listings open to the buyer

roles.name: Finance & GST
roles.description: Reviews the papers and reads the report

roles.name: Sustainability & BRSR
roles.description: Reads the report and the impact ledger

roles.name: Workspace admin
roles.description: Runs the workspace: people, guardrails, integrations, the audit log
